after.title: Bitcoin cycle swing trading
after.goal: A swing strategy that sells Bitcoin at peaks and reinvests proceeds into progressively larger positions.
after.how_it_trades: The strategy buys Bitcoin at entry signals on the daily chart, then sells half of the accumulated position at each peak. Cash from each sale funds the next buy, which draws from a larger pool than the last. No fresh capital is added, so gains compound into progressively larger positions over time.

after.title: Bitcoin accumulation through swings and dips
after.goal: A strategy that buys Bitcoin during consolidation and pullbacks, then takes profit as the price breaks higher.
after.how_it_trades: The strategy buys Bitcoin steadily during flat, sideways periods and continues buying into pullbacks. When price makes a decisive move higher, it takes profit on a portion of the position. It holds remaining Bitcoin and keeps buying on dips, only selling above its average cost as the price rises.

after.how_it_trades: Buys Intel in partial steps only when the price is below its average cost, building the position through the decline. On a sell signal, it exits a partial slice of the holding and banks that cash. The rest stays invested through the recovery, and new buys only trigger again if price falls back below average cost.

after.title: Trading the Bitcoin ETF decline
after.goal: A strategy for trading a falling Bitcoin ETF by buying pullbacks and selling into rallies.
after.how_it_trades: Buys with a portion of available cash at each signal and exits the full position at each sell signal. It only sells above its average cost. In this window it bought the February lows, sold everything into the April rally, rebuilt the position in July, and held through August.

after.goal: A patient approach to trading XLE through energy market cycles, aiming to hold cash when prices peak.
after.how_it_trades: On a weekly chart signal, it enters with all available cash. It only sells above its average cost, and when it does, it sells most of the position. Cash stays in the account until the next buy signal. Wide thresholds mean signals are infrequent, so the account may hold cash for long stretches.

after.title: Taking cash from Micron each week
after.goal: A weekly-signal strategy for collecting realized cash from Micron through its sharp decline.
after.how_it_trades: On each weekly buy signal, the strategy puts nearly all available cash to work in Micron. When a sell signal arrives, it exits most of the position, but only above its average cost, converting the swing into realized gains. Any unsold shares stay in the trade until the next signal.

after.title: Harvesting cash from Micron's 2026 run
after.goal: A swing trading strategy that captures cash from Micron's price moves across a volatile year.
after.how_it_trades: Deploys all available cash into Micron on a buy signal. On a sell signal, it exits ninety percent of the position, but only if the price is above average cost. The remaining ten percent stays in the trade, ready to anchor the next full entry when cash flows back in.

after.title: Accumulating Palantir through finer waves
after.goal: A strategy that trades Palantir's shorter price waves to build a larger share position over time.
after.how_it_trades: When a buy signal appears on the six-hour chart, the strategy commits most of its cash to Palantir. When a sell signal follows, it exits nearly the full position. Sitting in cash between trades, it reads smaller waves than a daily chart would, so it finds more opportunities to buy and add shares.

after.title: Palantir after the gap up
after.goal: For the investor who bought Palantir on its gap day, trading the subsequent swings to build returns.
after.how_it_trades: Buys with nearly all available cash when the signal fires and sells the full position into strength. The strategy bought through the spring lows, sold into the summer and November highs, and rebuilt through the 2026 decline, booking realized profit by selling into rising prices.

after.title: Palantir's 2026 harvest
after.goal: Trades Palantir's price swings to build a cash balance while keeping a position in the stock.
after.how_it_trades: The strategy tracks Palantir on an hourly chart. It buys with nearly all available cash when price falls below its average cost, and sells most of the position when price rises above that average. Cash raised from each sale waits on the sideline until the next dip arrives.

after.title: Accumulating Meta through the AI race
after.goal: Build a larger Meta position at a lower cost by buying into weakness and trimming into strength.
after.how_it_trades: On a buy signal, it deploys a fixed slice of available cash into Meta, but only when the price is below its average cost. On a sell signal, it trims a small fixed slice of the position, but only when the price is above its average cost. Cash from trims sits idle until the next buy signal arrives.

after.title: Meta through the capex whipsaw
after.goal: Harvests Meta's price swings into cash, buying dips and trimming positions into rallies.
after.how_it_trades: The strategy buys Meta with most of its available cash when price falls below its average cost. When a sell signal arrives, it trims most of the position into the rally. Between signals it holds cash, re-entering only when price dips back below its average cost.

after.title: Harvesting Meta through a flat year
after.goal: A strategy that buys Meta on deep dips and sells into rebounds, building cash in a directionless market.
after.how_it_trades: The strategy buys deep dips, committing most of its cash each time, but only when the price is below its average cost. On each rebound, it exits almost the entire position and returns to cash. It then waits for the next dip before buying again.
